# ARC-1 Compact R08 interconnect matrix (GENERATED by tools/gen_reports_r08.py from board/r08_board_plan.json)

Every signal net that touches at least two devices, after following series resistors (<= 1 kOhm).
'Inactive state' = the level set by board pulls while all drivers are high-Z/in reset (boot sampling, unpowered FPGA).
Devices: U15 F133, U16 boot NOR, U17 MN820 MISO buffer, U18 T35, U19 T35 config flash, U21-U24 SPI0 isolation, U25 PSRAM, U26 PSRAM pull-down switch, J3 MN820, J7 microSD, J1 USB-C, U28/U29 amps.
